test_title: PYST 17: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 24 Feb, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: T alone can complete a work in 90 days. In how many days will T complete 20 percent of the same work?
solution:
**Given:**

T can complete the entire work in 90 days.

**Formula used:**

Time to complete a fraction of work = Total time × Fraction of work

**Calculation:**

To complete 20% of the work:

Fraction of work = 20% = 0.2

Time required = 90 × 0.2

⇒ Time required = 18 days

**∴ T will complete 20% of the work in 18 days.**
